items.title: Research Engineer - Data Infrastructure
items.location_text: United Kingdom, United States, Poland, Bulgaria
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Research Engineer to join the research team at ElevenLabs, focused on the data infrastructure that powers our frontier AI models. The quality of our models is bounded by the quality and scale of the data behind them, and you will own the systems that make world-class data possible. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy: - Building large-scale data pipelines for collecting, processing, filtering, and transforming datasets used to train state-of-the-art models. - Training models used in our data processing pipelines, such as classifiers, quality filters, and labeling models. - Designing data curation strategies such as deduplication, quality scoring, labeling, and augmentation that measurably improve model performance. - Creating tooling and infrastructure that lets researchers explore and train on massive datasets quickly and reliably. REQUIREMENTS We do not require any formal certifications or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. Ideally, you bring: - Experience building data-intensive systems, ideally in support of machine learning training pipelines. - Strong engineering skills in distributed data processing at scale (e.g., Kubernetes, or custom pipelines over large datasets). - The capacity to autonomously evaluate how data quality, composition, and curation affect model outcomes, and to build the tooling to measure it. Bonus: Experience building or operating web crawlers. LOCATION This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Reseller Operations Manager, Japan & Korea
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is expanding its reseller program in Japan and Korea. As our Reseller Operations Manager for Japan and Korea, you'll own how resellers in both countries get onboarded, transact, get paid, and get supported, across both of our resale motions: hyperscaler resale, where partners resell Claude through the cloud marketplaces (AWS Bedrock today, Google Cloud Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry to follow), and direct resale, where partners resell on Anthropic paper through our own quote-to-order and billing systems. The global team builds the program; you make it work for Japanese and Korean partners and feed back what has to change. This is an operator role, not a partner manager role. In the first months you'll be validating deal registrations and answering partner tickets yourself; by the end of the first year the volume should be running on documented process, service levels, and vendor or system coverage that you set up. Key responsibilities Own reseller onboarding for Japan and Korea end to end: application intake, screening coordination, agreement execution, marketplace authorization, entitlement setup, and activation, and keep the partner record in Salesforce decision-grade for both regions. Run hyperscaler (3P) reseller operations: deal-registration intake and validation within SLA, marketplace authorizations and private-offer processing with the cloud alliance teams, and end-customer reporting on every reseller transaction so partner-sourced revenue can be attributed. Run direct (1P) reseller operations: partner quotes and order forms, order booking and provisioning, and commit tracking and true-ups with Deal Desk, RevOps, and Accounting, and work with Finance and Tax on local invoicing, currency, and consumption-tax handling for each transaction route. Run the regional side of reseller incentives: eligibility, validation of quarterly payouts, and partner disputes, in partnership with the global incentive operations team and Finance. Stand up first-line operational support for resellers in Japanese and Korean during local business hours, inside the global partner support queue rather than alongside it, and localize the onboarding, deal-registration, and ordering content partners depend on. Manage any outsourced or contracted operations capacity used in region (scope, quality, service levels) and coordinate with Enablement on the logistics of local-language certification and training. Own reseller reporting for Japan and Korea: registration volume and cycle time, activation, attach, and attributed revenue by partner and by motion, and use it to tell the regional teams and the global program what to fix next. Adopt the global Partner Operations playbooks where they fit, write the in-region variants where they don't, and represent Japan and Korea requirements in partner systems and automation work so manual volume doesn't grow with partner count. Minimum qualifications Several years in channel, reseller, distribution, or partner operations at a technology company, ideally touching both a cloud-marketplace motion and a direct or contract-based resale motion. Working proficiency in Japanese, Korean, and English. You'll run operational relationships with partners in both countries and work daily with a US-based team; proficiency doesn't need to be identical across all three, but you need to be able to work with partners in both regions. Practical knowledge of how at least one major cloud marketplace's reseller program works (authorizations, private offers, deal registration), or deep experience in one motion and a track record of picking up the other quickly. Hands-on experience with quote-to-order, order management, or partner billing, and the Finance, Deal Desk, and Legal coordination that comes with it. A track record of taking a manual process and turning it into documented workflow, service levels, and reporting, including managing vendors or contractors who execute part of it. Hands-on Salesforce experience (reporting, data maintenance), and comfort being the only operations person in the region while working with a team many time zones away. Preferred qualifications Experience inside the Japanese or Korean enterprise reseller and systems-integrator ecosystem, including local invoicing, credit, and consumption-tax conventions. Experience with partner incentive or rebate operations, or with a partner program during its launch phase. Experience with PRM or deal-registration tooling, or building automations with Claude or similar tools to run operational workflows at volume. How this role works with the team You'll report into Partner Experience and work day to day with two groups. The global Partner Operations team in San Francisco owns the reseller program's systems, and playbooks; our reseller operations owner there is your direct counterpart, and you'll split work along a simple line: they own the global process, you own its execution and adaptation in Japan and Korea. The Japan and Korea go-to-market teams own the partner relationships and the commercial conversations; you're the operational layer underneath them, and the person they come to when something about a partner's onboarding, order, or payout needs to move. You'll also be the regional voice into Finance, Deal Desk, RevOps, and the cloud alliance teams on anything that has to work differently in these markets. Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this. In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible. About the Role Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy. You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI. You’ll also collaborate with business partners to support customers’ business transformation and growth. This role is based in Tokyo, Japan. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Manage key accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan based on customers’ business priorities and growth opportunities. - Lead our enterprise prospects’ journeys from consideration to successful deployment. - Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects. - Collaborate with business partners to generate opportunities, develop joint proposals, and support deployment, expanding customer value and business opportunities. - Own a consumption revenue target. - Manage consumption revenue forecasts. - Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders. - Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies. - Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering. - Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates. - Support the development of company culture. Qualifications: - 7+ years selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service, or 7+ years of practical experience in customer business transformation. - Achieving revenue targets >$1M per year for more than 3 years. - Designing and executing complex deal strategies. - Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies. - Working directly with c-level executives. - Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders. - Leading high-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.). - Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence. You might thrive in this role if you: - Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future. - Are a builder. items.title: Account Director, Government
items.description: About the team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. OpenAI for Government (OAI4G) helps public-sector institutions understand, adopt, and deploy highly capable AI products in support of their missions. The team brings together Sales, Solutions, Partnerships, Technical Success, Legal, Security, Policy, Global Affairs, and other cross-functional partners to help governments use AI responsibly and effectively. As part of OAI4G’s International Public Sector team, you will help public institutions in Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) and APAC translate frontier AI into secure, compliant, mission-aligned outcomes. We work across varied procurement, regulatory, security, sovereignty, and commercial environments, while maintaining a consistent commitment to safety, reliability, and public benefit. About the role We are seeking a senior Account Director (AD) to lead OpenAI’s public-sector work across ANZ, with a wider remit to develop selected priority opportunities across APAC. ANZ will be the centre of gravity for the role: you will build trusted relationships with government leaders, develop and execute account strategies, create and close complex opportunities, and help customers move from initial interest to successful adoption. This is a full-cycle, highly cross-functional sales role that combines technical understanding, strategic vision, partnership management, and value-driven execution. You will work with senior government, operational, technical, procurement, policy, and security stakeholders to identify high-impact AI use cases and translate them into credible commercial and deployment pathways across the OpenAI Platform API and Codex and ChatGPT Enterprise. You will also be an accountable customer leader after signature, working alongside specialist delivery and technical teams to keep customer outcomes, milestones, adoption, risks, and executive alignment on track. The role requires excellent judgement, executive presence, local fluency, and the ability to move between strategy, discovery, capture, procurement, delivery governance, and relationship management without day-to-day direction. This role can be based in Sydney (Hybrid model, 3 days in office) or remotely from Canberra. In this role, you will - Own a focused portfolio of ANZ public-sector accounts, while developing selected priority opportunities in APAC in line with OAI4G’s international strategy. - Build and execute comprehensive account plans that map mission priorities, stakeholders, procurement paths, partners, use cases, risks, and long-term expansion opportunities. - Drive complex opportunities through the full sales cycle, from pipeline generation, discovery, qualification, capture, and commercial strategy through negotiation, closure, adoption, and expansion. - Lead public-sector customers through their AI adoption journey, helping them identify responsible, high-impact use cases and connect mission outcomes to OpenAI’s capabilities and limitations. - Translate between government leaders, end users, technical teams, policy and security stakeholders, and internal product and engineering partners, clearly communicating requirements, progress, risks, and dependencies. - Serve as the accountable customer lead for engagements tied to clear outcomes, customer milestones, adoption measures, and commercial commitments, coordinating closely with technical specialists. - Work closely with the Partnerships team, global and regional system integrators, cloud and technology providers, local delivery partners, resellers, and strategic international partners to shape joint pursuits, deployment models, and purchasing paths. - Develop capture strategies, competitive positioning, win themes, teaming decisions, and proposal narratives that reflect ANZ and relevant APAC market conditions. - Navigate public-sector procurement, tendering, security, data-residency, compliance, and sovereignty requirements, bringing Legal, Security, Policy, Global Affairs, Finance, and other partners into opportunities early. - Build trusted relationships with senior government executives and decision-makers, while staying close to operational users and technical stakeholders whose workflows determine successful adoption. - Maintain accurate pipeline, forecasting, account records, customer follow-up, and executive reporting, with disciplined follow-through across markets and time zones. - Monitor the government, technology, procurement, partner, and competitive landscape across ANZ and priority APAC markets, surfacing insights that inform product roadmaps and go-to-market strategy. - Represent OpenAI at government, partner, and industry forums, strengthening networks and identifying opportunities that advance responsible public-sector adoption of AI. We’re seeking someone with experience including - 10+ years in government, public-sector technology sales, business development, consulting, transformation, systems integration, or a closely related field, with meaningful ownership of complex customer outcomes. - Direct government experience or very significant experience working with government customers, ideally including sensitive agencies, national-security-adjacent environments, regulated missions, or high-consequence operational workflows. - A current Australian Government security clearance, with the ability to maintain the clearance required for the role. - Designing and executing complex deal strategies, including opportunity shaping before formal procurement, multi-stakeholder qualification, proposal development, negotiations, and closure. - Working directly with senior public-sector executives and decision-makers, alongside technical, operational, procurement, policy, and security stakeholders. - Navigating Australia’s public-sector procurement, contracting, security, privacy, data-residency, and compliance requirements; familiarity with New Zealand and/or other APAC public-sector environments is valuable. - Selling or delivering enterprise SaaS, cloud, AI/ML, data platforms, cybersecurity, API-based products, or other complex technology solutions in highly regulated environments. - Communicating technical, commercial, and strategic concepts clearly to both executive and working-level audiences, including the ability to explain where AI is and is not an appropriate fit. - Collaborating across Sales, Solutions, Partnerships, Research, Engineering, Technical Success, Legal, Security, Policy, Global Affairs, Finance, and Operations to move complex opportunities forward. - Operating with high ownership and sound judgement in ambiguous, fast-changing environments, while managing competing priorities across countries and time zones. - Travelling regularly within ANZ, and periodically across APAC, to work on-site with customers and partners. Nice to have - Deep relationships across Australian Commonwealth, state and territory, defence, national security, or other sensitive public-sector communities. - Experience building or working through local system-integrator, reseller, cloud-provider, or strategic-partner ecosystems. - Experience leading AI, digital, technology, or business-transformation initiatives from use-case shaping through deployment and adoption. - Familiarity with public-sector AI governance, responsible AI, cybersecurity, data sovereignty, and assurance requirements. - Experience developing opportunities across more than one APAC market and adapting to different political, cultural, regulatory, and procurement contexts. - Engineering, technical, policy, or operational experience that helps you translate complex AI capabilities into credible public-sector outcomes. You will thrive in this role if you - Are customer-centric. You work to understand public institutions’ missions and constraints deeply, and help them achieve meaningful outcomes with AI. - Are a strategist. You think years ahead, balance ANZ priorities with a broader APAC perspective, and align internal and external stakeholders around a clear point of view. - Are a builder. You create repeatable account, partner, capture, and delivery practices that can scale while adapting to local requirements. - Have strong judgement. You can navigate sensitive environments, incomplete information, competing priorities, and responsible-use considerations with integrity and composure. - Are technically curious. You can learn quickly, engage credibly with specialists, and translate frontier AI capabilities, limitations, and trade-offs for government audiences. - Care about public mission impact. You want to help governments use AI responsibly and effectively in ways that improve outcomes for the communities they serve. items.title: Marketing Scientist
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure the responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. In support of that mission, the Marketing team helps deeply understand customer audiences and market dynamics, influence the development of the right products, build sustainable and customer-aligned monetization models, and drive awareness, adoption, and usage across OpenAI’s products and platform. We take a data-driven approach to understand markets, develop monetization strategies, and uncover customer needs that shape product strategy and messaging. We partner closely with Sales, Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Research, Comms, and Design to deliver a cohesive end-to-end customer experience and lead go-to-market efforts for new product launches across channels. About the Role We’re looking for a Marketing Scientist to join OpenAI’s Ads Marketing Science function. Reporting to Marketing Science leadership, you’ll be a senior individual contributor who combines rigorous measurement expertise with strong client judgment and hands-on execution. Your mission is to help OpenAI Ads prove and improve advertisers’ media performance. You’ll work with sales, partners, and clients supporting all forms of measurement including verification, attribution, incrementality, brand, marketing mix modeling (MMM), and scalable advertiser reporting, connecting sound methodology to decisions advertisers can act on. You will partner closely with Sales on key advertising accounts and with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Partnerships, Legal, and Privacy. Initial priorities include advancing incrementality measurement, helping onboard measurement partners to privacy-forward measurement workflows and integrations, and creating reusable programs, tools, agents, skills, and workflows that let sales and clients access high-quality Marketing Science support at scale. items.title: Director, Litigation
items.description: Perplexity AI is looking for a sharp, entrepreneurial litigation attorney to join our small legal team to help advance the business, protect the products we are building, and revolutionize the way people search and interact with the internet. This unique role offers significant responsibility, direct ownership of high stakes matters, and growth potential across an in-house practice group. This is a unique role within a rapidly growing AI technology company. You will play a key role in safeguarding Perplexity’s interests by managing litigation files and pre-litigation disputes related to our AI answer engine, models, and technologies, while helping to build and scale our litigation function. You will oversee complex disputes in a fast-moving and often unsettled legal landscape, spanning intellectual property (including copyright), privacy, commercial, and regulatory matters, and you will work closely with our AI, engineering, and product teams to assess legal risk, develop litigation strategy, and provide guidance during disputes involving our products and services. The ideal candidate combines deep substantive knowledge of litigation practice and procedure with strong business judgment and practical problem-solving abilities. You are comfortable confronting novel legal issues, including questions where the rules are still being written, and you bring intellectual curiosity about AI technology, adaptability in an emerging landscape, and exceptional collaboration skills. Success in this role requires a deep understanding of high-growth startup environments, where you will pair traditional legal expertise with sharp business risk assessment. We are seeking someone who is inquisitive, has an entrepreneurial drive, and the agility to thrive in our fast-paced environment. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Manage litigation matters and pre-litigation disputes across all phases, including strategy, pleadings, motions, discovery, depositions, hearings, trials, and appeals, while developing comprehensive case strategies that align with business objectives. - Provide counsel across a broad range of disputes, including intellectual property (copyright, trademark, and trade secret), privacy, commercial, and regulatory matters, in both first-party and third-party contexts. - Evaluate and respond to litigation threats, demands, and disputes across jurisdictions, developing appropriate matter-resolution proposals that resolve issues with minimal disruption to the business. - Select, onboard, manage, and collaborate with outside counsel across all stages of disputes. Negotiate budgets and fee arrangements, monitor performance, and hold outside counsel accountable for delivering optimal results while maintaining cost efficiency. - Partner closely with AI, product, and engineering teams to proactively identify litigation risks in product development and go-to-market strategies, and to collect information efficiently in support of active matters. Translate complex legal requirements into practical, actionable guidance for technical teams. - Assist in responding to regulatory investigations and inquiries from government regulators and private organizations relating to our products and services. - Build internal litigation processes, policies, and tools, including legal-hold and discovery workflows, that support litigation and regulatory matters efficiently and can scale with company growth. - Monitor the evolving legal and regulatory landscape for AI, copyright, and privacy; translate court decisions, agency guidance, and legislative developments into timely, executive-ready advice; and communicate with business leaders about ongoing litigation, emerging risks, and preventive measures. QUALIFICATIONS - JD and in good standing with an active US state bar membership (California preferred) - At least 15+ years of law firm and/or in-house experience handling complex commercial litigation (with experience representing emerging technology companies preferred) - Deep substantive knowledge of litigation practice and procedure, with a demonstrated history of strong outcomes and effective case execution - Exceptional analytical, organizational, and collaboration skills, strong business acumen, and the ability to partner with business and technical teams - An ability to communicate clearly and credibly with business and technical audiences, including translating genuinely unsettled legal doctrine into concise, business-relevant advice for executives and engineers without over-hedging - Hands-on attitude to tackle projects large and small, and a low-ego, roll-up-your-sleeves approach to working across the organization - Excellent composure in stressful situations, high level of integrity, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to work independently with limited guidance while exercising good judgment about when to escalate - Thrive working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment NICE TO HAVE - Experience managing copyright and privacy litigation, as well as commercial disputes, for AI or other emerging technology companies - Experience managing regulatory responses or investigations, including both first-party and third-party responses - Experience building or scaling a litigation function at a growth-stage company, with creativity and an openness to novel solutions - Experience litigating cases in multiple jurisdictions, including internationally - A passion for supporting the development of AI that is both innovative and trustworthy

items.title: Public Policy Associate
items.description: ABOUT PERPLEXITY Perplexity is AI for people who expect more. More accuracy. More agency. More signal, less noise. Our answer engine handles hundreds of millions of queries every month for people whose questions spark change and whose decisions bend the world toward progress. As our footprint grows, so does the number of policymakers, agencies, and civil society leaders who want to understand what we are building and how we think. ABOUT THE ROLE We're hiring a Public Policy Associate in Washington, D.C. to sit at the center of Perplexity's engagement with Congress, the executive branch, trade associations, think tanks, and the broader D.C. ecosystem. This work happens where Washington happens, in Hill offices, in coalition meetings across town, and at the occasional evening event where the conversations that matter most actually take place. This is a relationship heavy, execution heavy seat. You've already worked both sides of the table, once inside a congressional office and once representing an organization before Congress, and you know how policy actually moves. Our Comms team and executive leadership set the strategy; you're our boots on the ground who makes it real. You'll build the stakeholder map, carry our message into the rooms that matter, and bring back what policymakers are saying, so that Perplexity shows up early, credibly, and consistently on the policy questions shaping AI. This role reports to the Senior Director, Product, Privacy & Regulatory Legal. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Execute our policy communications strategy set by our Comms and executive leadership teams. Turn company positions into talking points, event backgrounders, and rapid response, and feed intelligence back to our legal, policy, and product teams. - Build and hold relationships with Hill staff in personal offices and on committees, executive branch staff, trade associations, think tanks, and civil society organizations. - Advocate directly. Take meetings, deliver our positions, and follow bills and rulemakings that affect Perplexity, working within the company's lobbying disclosure and ethics requirements. - Run our D.C. event footprint. Hill staff briefings, roundtables, product demos, receptions, dinners, and off sites. Own guest lists, venues, run of show, and follow up. - Represent Perplexity in coalitions and trade association working groups. Track what's being said, flag what matters, and bring our point of view into the conversation. - Partner with think tanks and civil society groups on convenings, research launches, and joint programming. - Prepare our leaders for D.C. engagements. Briefing books, meeting prep, and post meeting recaps that actually get read. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - At least 3 years of professional experience, including time on Capitol Hill in a personal office or on a committee is strongly preferred. - External lobbying experience, either at a government relations or law firm representing clients, or in house at a company. Registered lobbying experience under the Lobbying Disclosure Act is strongly preferred. - A real Washington network you built yourself, and the instinct to keep growing it. - Event execution. You can run a 20 person Hill staff briefing or a 150 person reception end to end without anything slipping. - Strong writing. You can turn a meeting into a two paragraph readout and a briefing book into something a principal will actually use. - Sound judgment. You know what to escalate, what to handle, and how to represent a company in a room without a script. - Genuine curiosity about AI policy and the substance of what Perplexity is building. You don't need to be a technologist, but you do need to want to learn. - Comfort with the pace. Mornings, days, and evenings. This is a role for someone energized by the D.C. schedule. - Based in Washington, D.C. and in office four days a week, with occasional travel. BONUS - Hill experience on judiciary, commerce, intelligence, or AI focused portfolios. - Experience staffing a principal at a company, agency, or trade association. - Existing relationships across the AI and tech policy community in D.C.

items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. ElevenProductions is powered by a network of 500+ professionals across 15 language teams that combine industry expertise with a deep knowledge of AI tools. We are looking for Enterprise Account Executives to drive ElevenProductions growth across North America. You will work closely with Hollywood studios, TV networks, Big 5 book publishers, AAA gaming studios, and more to expand our service provider footprint and bring real-world use cases of ElevenLabs technology to life. Develop and execute strategies to expand ElevenLabs’ service provider footprint presence within key accounts 3. Partner closely with customer success and solutions engineering to ensure smooth onboarding and expansion of accounts. 4. Serve as a trusted advisor to customers in how they adopt and deploy ElevenLabs technology at scale REQUIREMENTS 1. 7+ years of quota‑carrying technology sales experience, ideally in Media & Entertainment 2. Deep understanding of and interest in the service provider approach – this is not about tools and automation, but about deep partnerships with customers that rely on us as an end-to-end service provider for professional-grade work 3. Comfort building exec-level relationships 4. Bonus points for: 1. Experience selling localization services to large Media & Entertainment customers 2. Experience bringing real-world use of AI audio technology to life in movies, TV, or or other broadcast media We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a Strategic Deals Lead, you will help shape Anthropic's long-term approach to AI infrastructure, compute capacity, and strategic ecosystem partnerships, and you will originate, structure, negotiate, and close the deals that put that strategy into effect. Within Cloud Compute, you will build and manage Anthropic's relationships across the emerging compute ecosystem to identify and execute opportunities that expand access to the infrastructure required to train and serve frontier AI systems. The compute market is fast-moving and structurally complex. Providers vary widely in scale, financial structure, and commercial model, and increasingly involve a variety of strategic partners. In this role, you will build and develop expertise across the relevant ecosystem players, commercial constructs and market standards, and the interplay between infrastructure and financing for scaling compute. You will work closely with Anthropic's technical infrastructure, finance, and legal teams to source and evaluate opportunities, develop deal economics, structure financing, and ensure transactions align with Anthropic's compute strategy. We are looking for someone with prior relevant transaction experience who is comfortable building and executing on a broad, active pipeline independently from day one. Key responsibilities Build and manage a pipeline of capacity across the integrated compute ecosystem Maintain and own executive level relationships with commercial, finance, and legal counterparts at providers across all stages of maturity Lead the full deal lifecycle for capacity agreements, from initial engagement and relationship development through negotiation, structure, and close of transactions Bring capital markets and finance expertise to transactions, developing frameworks for evaluating deal economics, counterparty risk, and the financing components of compute infrastructure Partner with infrastructure and technical teams to translate compute requirements into commercial terms and long-term supply strategies across the provider ecosystem Develop and maintain deep market intelligence on the emerging cloud and integrated compute landscape, including provider positioning, pricing dynamics, commercial model evolution, and the competitive dynamics shaping capacity access Represent Anthropic externally with corporate executives, investment banks, and infrastructure investors involved in transactions Drive internal alignment on transaction terms, risk parameters, and strategic priorities for Anthropic's compute supply Minimum qualifications Background in investment banking, private equity, or infrastructure investing, with direct experience in data center, cloud, or technology sector transactions Personal track record of originating, structuring, and closing cloud capacity, data center, or infrastructure transactions as the commercial, financing, or investing principal Deep familiarity with the compute ecosystem, including fluency in how different types of providers price and contract, how capacity commitments are structured, and how the integrated compute market operates Working understanding of the financing and infrastructure requirements of compute infrastructure projects Preferred qualifications 8-10+ years of experience in investment banking, infrastructure investing, or principal finance roles with ownership of cloud, data center, or compute transactions Experience managing multiple high-value transactions simultaneously at different stages of maturity and commercial development Demonstrated ability to build and maintain senior-level relationships with counterparts at commercially sophisticated, capital-intensive organizations Strong financial modeling skills, including the ability to build and pressure-test economics for large infrastructure projects Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where market structures, provider economics, and deal norms are still evolving A genuine interest in the trajectory of AI infrastructure and in Anthropic's mission of building safe, beneficial AI The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. items.title: Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineer, Multimodal)
items.description: We are hiring builders to define how people talk to, show things to, and hear from AI In 2026, we launched Computer, the defining product for the new era of agentic AI. We've scaled beyond the millions of people using Perplexity every day for research, shopping, investing and curiosity into a new paradigm of using AI to transform knowledge into action. The Multimodal team builds the experiences and infrastructure that move AI interaction beyond touch and text — realtime voice, vision, and the platform systems behind them. We own the full path from a user speaking into a device to an answer coming back: the realtime session infrastructure that connects clients to frontier audio models, the backend orchestration that routes, records, and supervises live sessions, and the SDK that powers voice and multimodal experiences across Perplexity's apps. As a backend engineer on Multimodal, you will design and scale the distributed systems that carry live voice sessions in production — and drive entirely new products at the intersection of voice, vision, and agents. WHY PERPLEXITY IS DIFFERENT - Craftsmanship. We build high quality, tasteful products targeting both the AI native and AI curious. - Ownership. You identify the problem, design the solution and ship it. - Entrepreneurship. We think like founders, act with urgency, and hustle to deliver for each other and our users. - Scholarship. Work among highly talented peers, pursuing knowledge and truth, upleveling ourselves, our teams, and our products. - Partnership. We amplify each others' strengths, break down silos, and give selflessly to help our colleagues deliver excellence. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design, build, and scale the backend session-worker architecture that powers realtime voice: durable per-session workers, provider routing, and stateful streaming over gRPC. - Own distributed-systems problems end-to-end — session lifecycle, crash recovery, reconnection and replay, multi-region deployment, and graceful degradation under real production load. - Build provider-agnostic streaming protocols from our backend to the Rust SDK that powers voice across every client stack. - Drive new products and initiatives in voice and multimodal AI from problem definition through technical design, implementation, and launch. - Build the orchestration layer that lets live voice models delegate work to tools, agents, and long-running tasks — safely, asynchronously, and at scale. - Partner closely with SDK, client, infrastructure, and model teams; work across the stack when the product demands it, from backend services to client-facing APIs. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 4+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend or distributed systems. - Strong experience in Rust, Python, or Go (we work primarily in Rust and Python). - Experience designing and operating production distributed systems: streaming RPC (gRPC or similar), stateful services, message-driven architectures, and failure recovery. - Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure — deploying, scaling, and operating services on AWS or equivalent. - Strong product judgment and the ability to translate user problems into simple, effective technical solutions. - Genuine interest and adoption of AI products and willingness to learn quickly. NICE TO HAVE - Experience with realtime media systems: voice, audio streaming, WebRTC, or low-latency transport. - Full-stack range — comfort building end-to-end, from backend services through client SDKs or web frontends. - Experience integrating LLMs, speech models, or computer vision into production systems. - Experience with agent frameworks, tool-calling architectures, or sandboxed execution environments. - Time spent at a fast-growing startup or on a high-ownership engineering team. OUR MISSION Perplexity’s mission is to power curiosity. Curious people are the people who drive change in the world. Driving change is a continuous cycle of learning, building, and integrating. Learn: curious people constantly learn new things by asking more. They question the status quo in their own expertise and they constantly learn outside of it. Research is essential to them and never ending. Build: curious people make and create things, to show the world their new answers to problems no one else ever questioned. They take action on what they’ve learned. Makers need tools to create their products, their companies, their reality. Integrate: they must interact with the world as it is to drive change and adoption. True leaders do not simply build something and hope. They must have armies of agents and workers who can constantly work in millions of small ways. Repeat. For curious people this is a cycle that never ends.

items.title: Member of Technical Staff (Secure Intelligence Institute)
items.description: Perplexity is seeking energetic researchers and engineers to join our Secure Intelligence Institute (SII), Perplexity's flagship research center for advancing security, privacy, and trust in frontier intelligence. SII’s goals are to advance frontier AI security research, translate those advances into concrete improvements in Perplexity's systems, and share knowledge and resources that strengthen the broader AI ecosystem. As a member of SII, you'll conduct original and impactful research on improving the security and privacy of frontier intelligence systems. Your goal will be to conduct research that is not only rigorous in theory, but practical enough to improve the systems people rely on every day. This work will be informed by the realities of operating general-purpose AI systems used by millions of people and thousands of enterprises, and you'll be expected to translate both your own research and advances from the broader community to practical improvements that protect and defend Perplexity's users. RESPONSIBILITIES - Develop threat models for emerging attack surfaces in AI-native products, including browser, search, and autonomous agents. - Identify and analyze security and privacy threats across AI systems, infrastructure, and user-facing products. - Develop novel defenses, mitigations, and detection mechanisms for security and privacy in AI-native products. - Build security evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and datasets to measure the effectiveness of different defense mechanisms. - Partner with Perplexity’s Security Engineering team to translate state of the art research into shipped security features and hardened system architectures. - Collaborate with top-tier academic and industry researchers in SII's external research network. - Publish findings at premier venues and contribute to the broader security research community. QUALIFICATIONS - Hold a PhD (or equivalent research experience) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with a primary focus on security and/or privacy. - Experience publishing at top security conferences (IEEE S&P, USENIX Security, ACM CCS, NDSS) demonstrating original, impactful research contributions. - Deep expertise in one or more of: security of agentic systems, systems security, web and applications security, program analysis, and software security. - Proficiency in Python (bonus points for TypeScript, Go, and/or Rust). - Ability to operate with high independence, willing to dive in and take ownership, and comfortable in a fast-paced environment where research directly informs product. - Clear and concise communcation, translating complex attack narratives into actionable insights for engineering and leadership.

items.title: Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineer, API Platform)
items.description: PERPLEXITY API PLATFORM Perplexity innovates at the frontier of AI infrastructure, search, and orchestration to serve the world's most discerning users. The Perplexity API Platform brings our technology to the world's most discerning developers. From exabyte-scale knowledge indexes to codegen-first agent runtimes, the building blocks behind Perplexity's applications are some of the most battle-tested AI systems in the industry. We believe these same building blocks can and should power the aspirations of builders everywhere. It's one thing to solve planet-scale retrieval, long-horizon orchestration, and other foundational AI challenges within a single product ecosystem. The true measure of success is to turn those solutions into elegant APIs that delight developers and agents alike. Our API Platform delivers frontier intelligence to thousands of customers: startups, trillion-dollar enterprises, U.S. and allied governments, and everyone in between. We've achieved incredible scale, yet we're just getting started. Join us to build tools for curious minds. ABOUT THIS ROLE Perplexity is seeking strong engineers with a passion for delivering frontier intelligence and infrastructure to developers. Our company builds technology that reshapes how people search, reason, and interact with the world around them. Week after week, we observe increasing demand for programmatic interfaces to that technology. The API Platform engineering team is charged with designing, implementing, and scaling these interfaces. As a member of our team, you'll work on an eclectic portfolio spanning distributed systems, performance optimization, agent orchestration, and frontier topics that often change with each passing month. Throughout this work, you'll prioritize great developer and agent experience alike. You'll also define technical strategy for how we scale to meet compounding growth exponentials (number of customers, agents per customer, compute/retrieval per agent, etc.). KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Design, build, and operate mission-critical APIs that provide our customers the building blocks for frontier intelligence. - Ensure low latency and high throughput through aggressive performance optimization (including on upstream systems). - Continually reimagine the customer needs of tomorrow (and the architectures to serve those needs), while faithfully serving the customer workloads of today. - Harden system security and reliability across heterogeneous compute environments. - Collaborate across teams to incorporate novel frontier capabilities into the API Platform and improve existing capabilities for API customer needs. - Uphold engineering excellence through design reviews, code quality, and internal documentation. QUALIFICATIONS - 5+ years of backend engineering experience with Python, Go, or Rust. - Strong understanding of high-traffic API design: schema evolution & versioning, idempotency, authentication patterns, rate limiting, and performance tuning. - Hands-on cloud experience (AWS preferred), along with fluency with Kubernetes, CI/CD, and modern DevOps practices. - Experience with modern AI APIs (including latency tuning, streaming, model orchestration, emerging technical standards) is a strong plus. - Strong customer empathy and product sense, ensuring the APIs you build are ergonomic, well-documented, and easy to adopt for developers and agents alike.

items.title: Sports Design Lead
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Sports is one of Polymarket's biggest growth vectors. We have active league partnerships and a product that maps naturally onto the sports betting and fan engagement space. What we don't yet have is someone who owns the creative layer of that entirely. This role exists to fix that. You'll sit within the Design team as a senior individual contributor, working directly with partnership, marketing, and product leads. The mandate is straightforward: build the creative systems that let us activate against marquee sports moments fast, look legitimate doing it, and stay on the right side of league compliance. That means co-branded campaign work, in-app design, paid social, CTV, experiential, and everything in between. This is not a support role. You'll own sports creative from brief to live, manage partner-side review cycles, and set the bar for what good looks like across the team. If you've spent time designing within the constraints of official league partnerships and you know the difference between generic sports creative and work that actually lands, this is the role. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Lead creative across all sports and league partnership activations, including co-branded campaigns, in-app integrations, paid social, display, CTV, and event assets. - Build and maintain partner-ready design systems: templates, toolkits, and brand frameworks that let the team activate quickly without starting from scratch each time. - Own licensing compliance across all sports creative, navigating league brand guidelines, marks usage, player imagery restrictions, and co-branding rules throughout the production process. - Manage partner-side creative reviews and approval workflows with league and media contacts, keeping feedback loops tight without letting them slow output. - Brief, direct, and QA motion designers on partner creative across social and CTV, raising the quality bar across the team while staying hands-on yourself. - Collaborate with performance marketing to iterate on paid social creative using live data, scaling what works and cutting what doesn't. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Proven experience leading design for sports or league partnership activations, with a portfolio that shows real co-branded creative work at scale. - Hands-on experience navigating licensing and rights compliance, including league brand guidelines, marks usage, and player imagery restrictions. - Portfolio that spans paid social (Meta and TikTok), display, CTV, and experiential or event assets. - Experience directing and QA-ing creative output from other designers, not just managing your own workload. - A sharp point of view on sports visual identity. You know what makes sports creative feel considered versus generic, and your past work shows it. - Comfort moving from brief to live in fast-moving, high-visibility environments where ambiguity is the norm and timelines are real. - Strong communication skills for managing external partner relationships and internal cross-functional feedback cycles. - (Plus) Experience designing within or alongside an official major league partnership context (NFL, NBA, MLB, or equivalent). - (Plus) Familiarity with prediction markets, sports betting, or financial product design. - (Plus) Experience working with or briefing motion designers on broadcast-adjacent creative formats. BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

items.title: Hardware Engineer, Test
items.description: About the Team: OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. Building on efforts like Jalapeño, the team is developing future generations of AI-native silicon and tightly integrated systems to power the next generation of frontier models. By co-designing chips, systems, tools, and methodologies, the team helps deliver faster, more efficient, and production-ready hardware for OpenAI’s supercomputing platform. In this role you will: - As a Hardware Test Engineer, you will work on Machine Learning/AI hardware system projects to craft the solutions for current and future data center deployments. - You will bring a strong understanding of hardware system testing, excellent project management skills, and the ability to collaborate across multiple teams to ensure efficient lab operations. - You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and executing comprehensive test plans that ensure the reliability, performance, and scalability of our supercomputing hardware systems. You will develop detailed test plans and methodologies tailored to hardware components, including processors, memory modules, custom accelerators and interconnects. - You will collaborate with hardware design, manufacturing, firmware teams and vendors to identify, analyze, and resolve issues affecting hardware, power, thermal and high-speed interconnects. You will perform in-depth debugging on the hardware system - Excellent analytical skills to diagnose hardware issues, troubleshoot problems, and propose solutions. Ability to interpret complex test data, identify trends, and draw meaningful conclusions. - High-speed links, with a focus on SerDes (Serializer/Deserializer) technology to assess signal integrity, error rates, and overall link performance. - You will collaborate with the lab manager to maintain the equipment and hardware systems, including oscilloscopes, thermal test chambers, liquid cooling systems, and other measurement devices. - You will utilize advanced diagnostic and measurement tools to capture performance metrics and analyze system behavior. You will develop and maintain automation scripts to streamline testing processes. Proficiency in Python, Bash and test automation frameworks to develop automated test scripts is highly desired. - Effective communication to clearly document test results, report defects, and collaborate with cross-functional teams. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have at least 10 years of industry experience, including experience testing or supporting hardware design teams for datacenter applications - Proven experience in hardware testing and validation, with hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, power supplies, analyzers, and other test instruments. - Have a strong understanding of electrical, power and thermal testing methodologies. - Have expertise with protocol of common interfaces such as SPI, I2C, USB, DDRx, and have experience characterizing and verifying compliance of Datacenter Ethernet interfaces. - Hands-on experience with high-speed electrical and thermal test equipment such as oscilloscopes, VNA, TDR, thermal cameras, heat sinks, and test chambers. - Experience in using Cadence Allegro and automation / scripting. - Have a strong bias toward action, and won’t take no for an answer. - Have experience and good knowledge of system testing from xPUs, board, rack level to data center level - Have a strong intrinsic desire to learn and fill in missing skills; and an equally strong talent for sharing that information clearly and concisely with others. - Are comfortable with ambiguity and rapidly changing conditions. - Have excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. items.title: Head of Brand
items.description: Full-time • Remote At Boldin, we believe that financial power belongs in the hands of individuals — not institutions. For too long, money has been controlled by systems that profit from complexity, fear, and dependence. We’re here to change that. We exist to democratize financial confidence, to give millions of people the clarity, tools, and courage to take control of their money and their time, and to live more meaningful lives. You will be joining Boldin at an exciting time. We have raised $20+M from top investors, are seeing tremendous growth, and we’re very optimistic about the future. About This Role This is not a traditional brand role. We are not looking for someone to “manage a brand.” We are looking for someone to build a movement. The Head of Brand is responsible for making Boldin synonymous with a powerful idea: Everyone deserves a financial plan — and the confidence that comes with it. You will define how Boldin shows up in the world — what we say, how we say it, and how it spreads. You will lead the systems that turn ideas into cultural momentum across video, social, PR, classes, and content. This role owns both brand narrative and brand performance — from awareness and perception to earned traffic, engagement, and downstream funnel impact. Key Responsibilities Define and lead the Boldin brand Own Boldin’s brand strategy, voice, and point of view Develop clear, compelling narratives that differentiate Boldin and resonate emotionally Ensure consistency and clarity across all channels and touchpoints Build a brand that stands for something — not just explains something Create a movement Evangelize the idea that everyone should have a financial plan Develop campaigns, ideas, and formats that spark conversation and cultural relevance Turn Boldin into a brand people talk about, share, and advocate for Identify and amplify moments that can create outsized impact Own brand distribution systems Lead and integrate Video, Social, PR, Classes, and (potentially) Content Manage and develop the brand and marketing design function, ensuring Boldin’s visual identity is clear, consistent, and distinctive across all touchpoints Ensure each channel reinforces the same core narrative in a native, high-performing way Build repeatable systems for creating, testing, and scaling ideas Drive measurable brand impact Own metrics including: Brand awareness and perception Earned traffic and direct arrivals Engagement and share of conversation Contribution to funnel conversion and growth Establish clear frameworks for measuring brand effectiveness Continuously test, learn, and improve Collaborate across the business Partner with Growth to align brand and performance marketing Partner closely with Brand/Marketing Design to ensure excellence and consistency in visual storytelling across all channels Work with Product to ensure brand promise is reflected in the user experience Collaborate with Content, Video, PR, and Social leads to execute at a high level Serve as a unifying force across teams and functions KPIS + Targets Significant increase in brand awareness and unaided recognition Growth in earned and direct traffic arrivals Increased engagement, sharing, and conversation across channels Stronger brand-driven conversion (registration, trial, subscription) Development of breakout campaigns or content with outsized reach Clear improvement in how users understand, trust, and connect with Boldin Qualifications You are a builder, storyteller, and strategist — someone who understands how brands become movements. You likely: Have a strong point of view on what makes brands culturally relevant Think in narratives, not campaigns Understand both emotional resonance and performance metrics Have experience turning ideas into distribution and reach Are as comfortable with ambiguity as you are with execution Care deeply about clarity, trust, and impact — especially in complex domains Requirements To succeed in this role, you must: 8+ years of experience in brand, marketing, or growth leadership roles Proven track record of building and scaling a brand with measurable impact Experience leading multi-channel brand efforts (video, social, PR, content) Strong understanding of how brand drives business outcomes Experience managing and developing high-performing teams Exceptional storytelling and communication skills Familiarity with personal finance, retirement planning, or willingness to develop deep expertise quickly Ability to balance long-term brand building with short-term performance Able to communicate top down: take ideas from stakeholders and bring them directly to your team or a specific role with an actionable game plan Compensation and benefits $185,000–$205,000 DOE Equity: early-stage options with real upside Health, dental, and vision coverage 401(k) with match Flexible PTO / parental leave Fully remote (US). If a candidate has only 80% of the skills but a fantastic attitude and perspective, they might be the perfect fit. Boldin values the unique perspectives and contributions of all individuals and we strive to foster a diverse and inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including and not limited to people of any race, ethnicity, or national origin, individuals with differing abilities, members of the LGBTQ+ community, veterans, gender minorities, women and people from underrepresented communities.We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with differing abilities throughout the recruitment process. If you require any accommodations, please let us know, and we will work with you to meet your needs. items.title: Corporate Counsel
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking an experienced Corporate Counsel to join our Legal Team. In this role you will work closely with the General Counsel in the corporate legal function, with a primary focus on M&A, strategic investments, financings, global expansion and overall public readiness. This role will work closely with Finance, People, and other teams around acquisition structure and post-acquisition integration, the company's fundraising and equity programs. Additionally, you will assist with designing the processes, agreements, frameworks and ways the broader team and business approach transactional and governance matters. Responsibilities - Legal lead for acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and other corporate transactions through the full lifecycle, including post-closing integration and structure. - Serve as the primary legal partner to Finance and Operations on deal strategy and execution, giving clear recommendations to key stakeholders. - Support the company's fundraising, including diligence, financing documents, side letters, investor rights, and coordination with outside counsel across a compressed timeline. - Partner with Finance and People on ElevenLabs' equity programs, including option and RSU grants, plan amendments, cap table hygiene, 409A process, and secondaries and tender offers. - Work with Finance, Tax and Operations on global expansion efforts - Advise on securities law questions that come with a fast-scaling private company. - Support corporate governance and entity work, including proper approvals, and subsidiary formation. - Design, maintain, and continuously improve templates, playbooks, diligence checklists, approval workflows, and signing and closing infrastructure to scale the corporate function. - Provide clear, pragmatic, and commercially focused legal advice to cross-functional teams, tailoring advice to enable responsible growth. Who you are - Curious about the future of AI and emerging technologies, have a strong sense of ownership with enthusiasm for applying your legal expertise to a company moving at unusual speed. - Experienced in navigating fast-paced, high-growth environments, with the ability to manage ambiguity and make informed, timely decisions. - A strong project manager who can run several live deals at once without dropping threads, and who chases the answer rather than waiting for it. - Comfortable working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and global colleagues. - Proactive, business-minded, and committed to delivering practical solutions that support both compliance and commercial success. - Interested in building the function, not just staffing the deals, and willing to leave behind better process than you found. - Hunger to be exceptional at your job. What you bring - J.D. and active membership in at least one U.S. State Bar. - 6+ years of relevant post-qualification legal experience at a major law firm, a high-growth technology company, or both. - Proven track record drafting and negotiating M&A and investment documents, including purchase agreements, term sheets, disclosure schedules, and ancillary deal documents as well as post acquisition integration. - Substantive experience with venture or growth-stage financings and the securities law questions that come with them. - Working knowledge of equity compensation, including plan administration, grant mechanics, and liquidity events such as secondaries and tender offers. - Strong corporate generalist instincts, with enough governance and entity experience to keep transactions clean on the back end. - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. - Comfort in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities and tight deadlines. - Public company experience strongly preferred Location This role is remote and can be executed in the United States, with a preference for New York or San Francisco, where the company has offices and significant presence. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customer’s adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises. About the Role We are looking for a leader to build and scale our Support Engineering team, which will collaborate directly with our strategic enterprise accounts, our product and engineering teams, as well as our field teams to solve some of the most difficult technical problems faced by our customers. You will lead one of the best technical troubleshooting teams at OpenAI, and our customers and Engineering teams will look to you for technical guidance in addressing the most technically difficult issues in our environment. You will play an integral role in building knowledge within the team and be part of strategic initiatives for organizational and process improvements. Working directly with our most strategic customers - You will be crucial to the success of the most innovative, disruptive, and high-scale AI solutions being built with the OpenAI platform. This team will handle high difficulty situations and issues. The team will be global, providing 24x7 technical coverage for our customers. This will be an opportunity to build this new team from first principles - your leadership will determine the future of this organization. The ideal candidate will have a combination of technical capabilities mixed with strong leadership and systems building strength. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.
