items.description: Perplexity is seeking an Applied AI Architect to help our customers turn Perplexity Computer into working solutions that drive measurable impact. This role is ideal for technical, consultative professionals who have led complex software implementations and can move comfortably between customer discovery, solution design, hands-on delivery, and executive communication. About the role Perplexity Computer is a new class of AI system that navigates tools, interacts with applications, and completes multi-step workflows end to end. Our customers are using Computer to transform work that traditional software has not been able to address. You will work closely with Sales and Customer Success while serving as a quality filter for requests that require Product or Engineering. What you'll do - Lead technical discovery. Work with customer business leaders, technical teams, account executives, and customer success managers to understand the users, current workflow, desired outcome, constraints, and decision-makers. - Design credible solutions. Map how people, data, tools, approvals, permissions, and decisions interact, then determine how Computer can support the workflow. - Support complex opportunities. Partner with account executives on technical deal strategy, demos, proofs of value, architecture and security coordination, and engagement scoping. - Drive value-backed consumption. Validate product and engineering needs and produce decision-ready requests with clear evidence, constraints, impact, and acceptance criteria. - Turn every engagement into leverage. Convert repeated customer needs into reusable workflows, implementation patterns, demos, guidance, and product feedback. What we're looking for The strongest Applied AI Architects combine technical depth, consultative problem solving, and disciplined engagement delivery. You should be comfortable working hands-on with the product, advising customer executives, and managing the details required to deliver a successful outcome. Must-haves - 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as solutions architecture, senior sales engineering, AI implementation, forward deployed work, technical consulting, or technical program leadership. - Proven consultative discovery skills. You can turn an ambiguous request into a clear business problem, technical approach, and delivery plan. - Hands-on technical fluency. You are comfortable with APIs, integrations, authentication, identity, permissions, connectors, data flows, and technical troubleshooting. - Experience delivering complex implementations. You have managed scope, stakeholders, milestones, risk, expectations, and closure. - Strong solution judgment. You can distinguish education, configuration, implementation, support, product, and engineering problems and recommend the right path. - Commercial and consumption awareness. You can connect solution design and technical decisions to time to value, usage, credit consumption, customer economics, and expansion potential. - Executive-credible communication. You can explain technical trade-offs to senior decision-makers while working effectively with practitioners and engineers. - High agency in ambiguity. You can establish direction without waiting for perfect requirements, challenge weak assumptions, and make thoughtful decisions quickly. - AI-native working style. You use frontier models and AI tools regularly and have developed strong intuition for what current systems can and cannot do reliably. Nice-to-haves - Experience deploying agents or multi-step LLM workflows in complex enterprise environments. - Experience with Computer, MCP, enterprise identity, security, permissions, or workflow orchestration. - Experience in regulated or workflow-intensive industries such as legal, financial services, healthcare, or technology. - Prior forward deployed engineering, Applied AI, deployment strategist, solutions architecture, or technical consulting experience at an AI or enterprise software company. - A track record of turning customer implementations into reusable technical assets or product improvements.

items.title: Senior Product Manager: Retention & Engagement
items.description: Senior Product Manager Full-time • Remote At Boldin, we believe financial confidence should be accessible to everyone. Money decisions shape our lives, yet too often people are left without the clarity or tools they need to make informed choices. We exist to change that. Boldin is a comprehensive financial planning platform that helps people understand their financial picture, make smarter decisions with their money and time, and plan for the future with confidence. With over $20M raised and strong momentum, Boldin is entering a pivotal phase of growth. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven team and help shape the future. About This Role Why this role is different Most retention jobs are about keeping people subscribed to something they could live without. Our subscribers are deciding when and how to retire. That is the biggest financial decision most people ever make, and the ones who build a planning habit make better decisions than the ones who set a plan and forget it. Improve engagement here and you've helped someone retire with confidence instead of anxiety. A few things you'll inherit that most PMs would love to have: A product people love. Boldin has an active community forum with users who write to us unprompted to say the platform changed their retirement. When you want to talk to customers, they answer. Real ownership. You own retention for our core subscription product end to end. You report to the Head of Product and work directly with leadership. A rich problem. Financial planning is complicated and emotional. Making professional-grade planning feel simple to a first-time planner is one of the better design problems in consumer software, and it's the center of this role. What you'll do Own retention and engagement outcomes for PlannerPlus. Define the metrics framework, find the root causes of churn, and fix them in the product. Design the rituals and return moments that turn a one-time plan into a planning habit. Take sophisticated planning capabilities, like Roth conversions and withdrawal strategies, and turn them into experiences a first-time planner can use with confidence. Spend real time with subscribers across ages, incomes, and levels of financial literacy, and let what you hear shape the roadmap. Run disciplined experiments and cohort analyses. Be honest about what moved and what didn't. Make retention a company-wide muscle. Share the strategy, the data, and the wins. Your first year First 90 days. Get deep into the product, the data, and the subscribers. Ship your first experiment. Publish the retention metrics framework the company aligns around. By month 6. You own a prioritized retention roadmap tied to root causes, with early wins shipped and measured. By month 12. Retention is moving, engagement rituals are live, and you're the person the company asks about why subscribers stay. What we're looking for 5+ years of B2C product management experience, including direct ownership of retention, engagement, or lifecycle outcomes for a subscription product Fluency in subscription economics. You think in cohorts, LTV, and payback, not just conversion. Strong analytical chops. You can design an experiment, pull your own data, and tell when a result is real. You communicate well enough that engineers, designers, marketers, and executives all feel like one team. Empathy for people who don't think about money all day, and respect for how emotional financial decisions are A real interest in personal finance and retirement planning. Many of us are power users of our own product. items.title: Trade Surveillance Associate, Derivatives
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Trade Surveillance Associate in the Market Regulation Department of Coinbase Derivatives, LLC (CDE), this is a hands-on trade surveillance role where you'll help ensure the integrity of Coinbase's CFTC-registered designated contract market by monitoring trade activity, investigating potential violations, and enforcing CDE's rulebook. Working closely with the Chief Regulatory Officer and Market Regulation Department, you'll analyze surveillance alerts, conduct investigations into disruptive trading practices, and produce the reports and documentation that support CDE's regulatory obligations as a self-regulatory organization. What you'll do: Investigate potential trade practice violations, including spoofing, wash trading, money pass activity, front running, fraud, and other disruptive trading activity by CDE participants to ensure compliance with CDE's rulebook and applicable CFTC regulations. Analyze alerts generated by CDE's trade surveillance system, triaging and escalating matters that require heightened review in partnership with Market Regulation Department leadership. Produce investigative reports documenting observations, findings, and assessments, maintaining compliance with recordkeeping requirements for all inquiries and investigations. Deliver updates and presentations to the Chief Regulatory Officer, CDE Board, and Regulatory Oversight Committee on matters related to trade activity in accordance with CDE rules and procedures. Identify patterns and trends across surveillance data that may indicate emerging market risks or systemic compliance gaps, recommending process improvements to strengthen the program. Required Skills and Experience: 3+ years of experience providing market and trade surveillance support for regulated entities (DCMs, DCOs, exchanges, broker-dealers, or comparable). Sound understanding of market fundamentals, derivatives trading practices, and investigative and surveillance techniques, with the ability to apply CFTC regulations and exchange rulebooks to specific trading scenarios. Demonstrated ability to produce clear, well-organized investigative memoranda, reports, and presentations that synthesize complex trading data for stakeholders at all levels, including regulators. Experience managing multiple concurrent investigations and regulatory deadlines while maintaining accuracy and thoroughness across all active matters. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus): $108,630 — $127,800 USD Application Limit: Candidates may submit a maximum of 3 applications within a 6-month period. Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. US Applicants: View Employee Rights , Know Your Rights , and E-Verify Notice of Participation. Accommodations: If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations[at]coinbase.com. Need screen reading technology? Click here to download a free compatible screen reader and view the tutorial . items.title: Program Manager - IT Operations
items.description: About the Team The Employee Technology & Experience (ETX) team is responsible for delivering a world-class internal technology experience that enables employees to do their best work. We support and operate the employee-facing systems that keep the company moving quickly and efficiently. ETX spans support, logistics, AV, identity, endpoints, SaaS administration, automation, enterprise tooling, and internal infrastructure operations. We partner closely with Security, Engineering, Workplace, Finance, People, and other teams to keep OpenAI’s internal technology reliable, scalable, and moving at the pace of the company. About the Role We are hiring a Program Manager to help scale how IT operates across OpenAI. This role will lead complex cross-functional programs that improve operational maturity, streamline how teams work together, and turn high-impact initiatives into durable operational capabilities. You will work across IT, Security, Engineering, Workplace, and other functions to drive alignment, remove friction, and help build the operational foundation needed to support OpenAI’s rapid growth. You’ll be responsible for: - Lead cross-functional operational programs that improve scalability, consistency, and operational maturity. - Drive operational excellence initiatives across IT Support, employee lifecycle operations, meeting room and calendaring services, onsite support, vending, and research support environments. - Build operating models, readiness plans, escalation paths, governance cadences, and success metrics for complex operational programs. - Partner with technical teams to ensure new deployments, infrastructure investments, and internal platforms are operationally ready and sustainably supported at scale. - Drive high-priority operational programs supporting company growth, including infrastructure expansion, operational integrations, and other emerging initiatives. - Improve operational visibility, stakeholder alignment, and coordination across long-running cross-functional initiatives. - Create clarity across complex operational programs by establishing clear ownership, execution plans, operational accountability, and durable follow-through. - Own intake, prioritization, coordination, and completion of operational work originating from cross-functional teams and stakeholders. We’re looking for someone with: - 10+ years of program management experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives in high-growth, fast-moving environments. - Experience building and scaling operational processes, service models, and operating frameworks across technical and operational teams. - A strong track record improving internal operations, workplace technology, support environments, or other large-scale service-oriented programs. - Excellent judgment and execution skills, with the ability to drive prioritization, alignment, and sustained momentum across multiple teams and competing demands. - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate effectively with both technical and non-technical partners. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link https://form.asana.com/?k=bQ7w9h3iexRlicUdWRiwvg&d=57018692298241. Join us in shaping the future of technology.
